craft_notes: Sthāyin: desire-lead (see, don't kill: lead to calm where it arose). Rows: row 3 (arose→dissolves). Close: dissolves (līyate — dissolve-verb family returns: where IT arose, THERE it dissolves — the locality refrain). Rejected: 'suppress desire' — killed: lead kept (nayet — guide); 'watch it' flat — killed: lead it kept (the verse is directional).

lines: Sudden desire arisen, seen — lead to calm:
where it arose, there right there dissolves.
l4.sanskrit_cite: jhagitīcchāṃ samutpannām avalokya śamaṃ nayet | yata eva samudbhūtā tatas tatraiva līyate

reads_against.argmap: What dissolves sudden desire? → Seen desire led to calm dissolves where it arose.
c1_essence: Seen desire led to calm: dissolves where it arose.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta tipping into śānta (wonder at identity unmade)
